h_regions.name: Single-family founder report

h_regions.name: Loss-of-function allelic spectrum

h_regions.name: Cross-gene mechanistic precursor

h_regions.name: Conference-to-publication bridge

h_regions.name: Independent second family
h_regions.description: A separate, unrelated patient pedigree or cohort with biallelic PSMF1 variants and similar phenotype that is distinct from the original core family/pedigree and not merely a follow-up screen or reanalysis.

h_regions.name: Negative cohort screening
h_regions.description: Papers that explicitly report screening a Parkinson disease cohort for PSMF1 variants and finding none, or only rare findings without establishing a new family, serving as negative or low-yield follow-up evidence.
